Team — forwarding Samantha’s note and my proposed sprint split. This is the CS -> Implementation handoff; I’ll own timeline and status reporting. Please keep the thread when you update Jira.

Summary of scope:
1) VPC peering + routing (Evelyn) — confirm peering CIDRs, route table entries, and security group rules. Acceptance criteria: successful ping to private endpoint IPs from our peered test instance, and no access to other VPCs.
2) Private endpoints / interface endpoints (Aditya) — deploy endpoint interfaces, validate TLS handshake, confirm header-based allowlists if requested. Acceptance criteria: API responds over private path and token exchange completes.
3) On-prem package validation (Aditya + Evelyn) — provide installer for air-gapped staging, run offline install, run the provided verification checklist (we’ll capture logs).
4) Compliance gating (Monica) — gather audit log configuration, retention settings, and hand off SOC2 evidence required by their compliance team.
